{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Obi-Wan! My friend! Why didn't you come back to the kitchen and greet me? And you brought the tadpole with you!|[[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], on [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="TFP">''[[Jedi Quest: The False Peace]]''</ref>}}
A '''tadpole''' was the [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] [[Larva/Legends|larval]] stage in the life cycle of some [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibian]] [[Species/Legends|species]], including the [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrians]], the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]], the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], and the [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolans]].<ref name="TNEGtAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>
